final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country != '' GROUP BY m.player_id, p.death_country), step2 AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1 GROUP BY death_country) SELECT step1.player_id, step1.death_country, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total_cnt as ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.death_country = step2.death_country ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
